Different Strokes

Download Now

🖼️ Everyone's favorite collaborative online painting game! 🖌️

We started a Discord Server! 💬

Feel free to join to share your work, your favorites, and talk with other players/artists! 🖌️

⭐ Deluxe Edition ⭐

To help pay for server costs we have introduced a Deluxe Edition that includes several special features: 9 exclusive colors! smaller brush sizes brush smoothing straight line tool canvas zoom studio room for viewing your paintings/liked paintings painting easel for saving draft paintings We really need your support to keep this game running so we hope you'll consider making this one time donation to unlock the latest features!

Your friend, a conceptual artist, has invited you to their latest exhibition.

You enter expecting to see their art adorning the walls, but to your surprise, the VISITORS are the ones drawing the art — they’re even drawing over each other’s work! It’s up to you to protect the exhibition from being covered in artwork that is, intentionally or otherwise, truly awful.

  • Explore a never-ending, ever-expanding gallery full of user-generated art — and snarky guests!
  • Add a new layer to art that needs a redo!
  • Draw new art to fill the exhibition!
  • Rate art to boost the good and hide the bad!
All of the art exhibited in the game is 100% created and remixed and rated LIVE by other players. Yes, we host all of this art and load it in dynamically. We hope that you will choose to fix the (inevitable) unacceptable art!

In addition to the main gallery there is also a portal to the "gallery of the week". Every week there will be a new gallery with a particular theme. The main gallery is pretty crowded so your art may have a better chance of standing out in the gallery of the week!

Controls

  • WASD - Move
  • E - Interact
  • Space - Jump / Skip dialog
  • B - Brush Tool
  • G - Paint Bucket Fill Tool
  • CTRL+Z - Undo
  • ESC or P - Settings Menu
  • [ or ] or mouse wheel - Change brush size

poison.ivy.maze7 days ago (1 edit)

True. Some people are VERY good!

However there's a technique for even the artistically challenged... it won't get you votes, but it can be fun to mess around.

I've found that if you scribble all over the canvas in black, then swap to white scribble, then switch back and forth; you will make a mess, sure, but in those lines you might be able to 'see' an image of something (as the brain likes to find patterns as with Pareidolia). When you can see the outline of something in the messy environment, use your brush to enhance what you see so it looks more like what your brain thinks it should be. 

A finished subject amidst  a mess of random chaos ends up appearing in a grimy dreary dangerous aesthetic with horror feels. That's something one can make with only a mouse at least.

poison.ivy.maze7 days ago (2 edits)

One word of warning... keeping an open mind to find possible images is very useful; but also, you should also take regular breaks.

The mind can obsess when one finds mastery with a new thinking pattern. Pareidolia is great for being artistic, but it can be annoying when you can make out shapes in real life. (I think that's what Jonathan Blow was commenting on in the final scene of the game 'the witness'. In his case, it was about habitual application of pattern recognition rather than Pareidolia, but the same theme holds true.)
